001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.pattern.format;
002
003import java.nio.charset.Charset;
004import java.time.Instant;
005import java.time.ZoneId;
006import java.util.Locale;
007import java.util.function.Function;
008
009import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
010
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEncoder;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogOutput.OutputType;
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
015import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty;
016import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider;
017import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProviderRef;
018import io.jstach.rainbowgum.ServiceRegistry;
019import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.CaseChanging;
020import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable;
021import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable.ConvertParameter;
022import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable.KeyParameter;
023import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable.PassThroughParameter;
024import io.jstach.rainbowgum.pattern.format.DefaultFormatterConfig.StandardPropertyFunction;
025import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider;
026import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator;
027import io.jstach.svc.ServiceProvider;
028
029/**
030 * Configures Logback style pattern encoders and offers provision with the URI scheme
031 * {@value PatternEncoder#PATTERN_SCHEME}.
032 *
033 * @see PatternEncoderBuilder
034 */
035@ServiceProvider(RainbowGumServiceProvider.class)
036public final class PatternConfigurator implements Configurator {
037
038        /**
039         * Where the pattern encoder is used: see {@link Mode}. Default is
040         * {@link Mode#CONSOLE}.
041         * <p>
042         * Property: <code>{@index logging.pattern.mode}</code>
043         */
044        public static final String LOGGING_PATTERN_MODE_PROPERTY = LogProperties.ROOT_PREFIX + "pattern.mode";
045
046        /**
047         * Where the pattern encoder is used, from {@value #LOGGING_PATTERN_MODE_PROPERTY}.
048         */
049        @CaseChanging
050        public enum Mode {
051
052                /**
053                 * The pattern encoder, with a default pattern, replaces TTLL as the encoder of
054                 * console output that does not name one, and is used wherever an encoder names
055                 * the {@value PatternEncoder#PATTERN_SCHEME} scheme. The default.
056                 */
057                CONSOLE,
058                /**
059                 * The pattern encoder is used only where an encoder names the
060                 * {@value PatternEncoder#PATTERN_SCHEME} scheme, so console output that does not
061                 * name one keeps the TTLL encoder.
062                 */
063                EXPLICIT;
064
065                static Mode parse(String value) {
066                        return LogProperty.enumValue(Mode.class, value);
067                }
068
069        }
070
071        /**
072         * For service loader to call.
073         */
074        public PatternConfigurator() {
075                // for service loader.
076        }
077
078        @Override
079        public int priority() {
080                return -1 << 2; // internal group 2
081        }
082
083        static final String DEFAULT_PATTERN = """
084                        %cyan(%date{HH:mm:ss.SSS}) %clr([%thread]){faint} %highlight(%-5level){ERROR=red bold, INFO=blue bold, WARN=red bold} %magenta(%logger{36}) - %msg%n%ex""";
085
086        @Override
087        public boolean configure(LogConfig config, Pass pass) {
088                var services = config.serviceRegistry();
089                String n = ServiceRegistry.DEFAULT_SERVICE_NAME;
090                services.putIfAbsent(PatternRegistry.class, n, PatternRegistry::of);
091                services.putIfAbsent(PatternCompiler.class, n, () -> PatternCompiler.of(b -> {
092                }).provide(n, config));
093                config.encoderRegistry().register(PatternEncoder.PATTERN_SCHEME, new PatternEncoderProvider());
094                config.reporter().addProperty(PatternConfigurator.class, LOGGING_PATTERN_MODE_PROPERTY);
095                var mode = config.properties()
096                        .forKey(LOGGING_PATTERN_MODE_PROPERTY)
097                        .ofString()
098                        .map(Mode::parse)
099                        .or(Mode.CONSOLE)
100                        .validateNow(PatternConfigurator.class);
101                if (mode == Mode.CONSOLE) {
102                        config.encoderRegistry().setEncoderForOutputType(OutputType.CONSOLE_OUT, (name, c) -> {
103                                PatternEncoderBuilder b = new PatternEncoderBuilder(name);
104                                b.pattern(DEFAULT_PATTERN);
105                                b.fromProperties(c.properties());
106                                return b.build().provide(name, config);
107                        });
108                }
109                return true;
110        }
111
112        @LogConfigurable(name = "PatternEncoderBuilder", prefix = LogProperties.ENCODER_PREFIX + "pattern.")
113        static LogProvider<LogEncoder> provideEncoder(@KeyParameter String name, String pattern,
114                        @PassThroughParameter @Nullable PatternCompiler patternCompiler,
115                        @ConvertParameter("convertCharset") @Nullable Charset charset, @Nullable Integer maxBufferSize) {
116                return (n, config) -> {
117                        var compiler = patternCompiler;
118                        if (compiler == null) {
119                                compiler = PatternCompiler.of(b -> {
120                                }).provide(name, config);
121                        }
122                        var formatter = compiler.compile(pattern);
123                        var builder = LogEncoder.builder(formatter);
124                        builder.description(pattern);
125                        if (charset != null) {
126                                builder.charset(charset);
127                        }
128                        if (maxBufferSize != null) {
129                                builder.maxBufferSize(maxBufferSize);
130                        }
131                        return builder.build().provide(n, config);
132                };
133        }
134
135        static Charset convertCharset(String charset) {
136                return Charset.forName(charset);
137        }
138
139        @LogConfigurable(name = "PatternConfigBuilder", prefix = PatternConfig.PATTERN_CONFIG_PREFIX)
140        static PatternConfig provideFormatterConfig(@KeyParameter String name, //
141                        @ConvertParameter("convertZoneId") @Nullable ZoneId zoneId, //
142                        @Nullable String lineSeparator, //
143                        @ConvertParameter("convertAnsi") LogConfig.Globals.@Nullable AnsiMode ansi, //
144                        @PassThroughParameter @Nullable Function<String, @Nullable String> propertyFunction, //
145                        @PassThroughParameter @Nullable Instant startTime, //
146                        @ConvertParameter("convertSequenceNumberStart") @Nullable Long sequenceNumberStart, //
147                        @ConvertParameter("convertAbbreviatorCache") PatternConfig.@Nullable CacheType abbreviatorCache) {
148                PatternConfig dc = PatternConfig.of();
149                ansi = ansi == null ? dc.ansi() : ansi;
150                lineSeparator = lineSeparator == null ? dc.lineSeparator() : lineSeparator;
151                zoneId = zoneId == null ? dc.zoneId() : zoneId;
152                propertyFunction = propertyFunction == null ? StandardPropertyFunction.INSTANCE : propertyFunction;
153                startTime = startTime == null ? Instant.now() : startTime;
154                long sequenceNumberStart_ = sequenceNumberStart == null ? dc.sequenceNumberStart() : sequenceNumberStart;
155                abbreviatorCache = abbreviatorCache == null ? dc.abbreviatorCache() : abbreviatorCache;
156                return new SimpleFormatterConfig(zoneId, lineSeparator, ansi, propertyFunction, startTime, sequenceNumberStart_,
157                                abbreviatorCache);
158
159        }
160
161        /*
162         * The same values as logging.global.ansi.mode, including its true and false aliases.
163         */
164        static LogConfig.Globals.AnsiMode convertAnsi(String s) {
165                return switch (s.strip().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT)) {
166                        case "TRUE" -> LogConfig.Globals.AnsiMode.ON;
167                        case "FALSE" -> LogConfig.Globals.AnsiMode.OFF;
168                        default -> LogProperty.enumValue(LogConfig.Globals.AnsiMode.class, s, "true", "false");
169                };
170        }
171
172        static Long convertSequenceNumberStart(String s) {
173                return Long.valueOf(s);
174        }
175
176        static PatternConfig.CacheType convertAbbreviatorCache(String s) {
177                return PatternConfig.CacheType.parse(s);
178        }
179
180        static ZoneId convertZoneId(String zoneId) {
181                return ZoneId.of(zoneId);
182        }
183
184}
185
186record PatternEncoderProvider() implements LogEncoder.EncoderProvider {
187
188        @Override
189        public LogProvider<LogEncoder> provide(LogProviderRef ref) {
190                return (name, config) -> {
191                        PatternEncoderBuilder b = new PatternEncoderBuilder(name);
192                        b.fromProperties(config.properties(), ref);
193                        return b.build().provide(name, config);
194                };
195        }
196
197}
